en: The image shows the back of a vintage postcard with printed and handwritten text in Estonian. On the left is a printed sender line reading "Eduard Vilde Mälestuse Jäädvust. Kor… Tartu, Aia 19…". In the center-right there is a brown postal form label glued onto the card with printed Estonian text and several handwritten entries, including a location written as "Tallinnas". Postal cancellation marks and a green stamp are partially visible on the right edge. At the bottom right, the destination city "Tallinn" is written in large cursive handwriting.
